headline: Whitman finishes atop the NWC table
dek: Whitman closed the season with fourteen wins, three draws, and four losses across all matches, collecting more victories than any other NWC program. Even a heavy closing loss to North Park could not alter its place atop the conference standings.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Attacking output drops off steeply down the NWC table, with Whitman's 40 goals exceeding the combined scoring of Whitworth and Lewis & Clark.

wire.line: Pacific Lutheran scored 29 goals and conceded twelve all season, finishing with twelve wins, five draws, and three losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Puget Sound forward Jackson Smith recorded eleven goals and six assists on 71 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Whitworth goalkeeper Oliver Hart made 74 saves while allowing seventeen goals, posting a 0.813 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: At least thirteen different players scored for Linfield during the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six non-conference matches involving Lewis & Clark, Whitworth, and Pacific (Ore.) have passed their scheduled dates with no published result.

last_match.line: Whitman entered the match atop the NWC table after beating Pacific Lutheran in its closing conference match.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
